title: The Figure Read Twice

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The slate is read twice so that those who came late may hear what those who came early heard. The third thing, which is the price, nobody reads aloud, and the space where it should stand has no signature.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Cross, told under the moot-post in the second week of Bone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and eighteen to three hundred and twenty days, six months and one hundred and thirty-eight to one hundred and forty days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register takes the body in its old order each morning — crust two inches from the ear, gone leathery in the dry kiln heat with its corner standing a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and reads the world the way a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that the infant's want of the crust is louder than the surgeon's knowing and neither wins; the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, not numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid. Five arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure after Bone's second reading: one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer. The staying at the inch and the early letting-go of Bone 17 remain two objects on two places with a finger between them and every other object, neither a habit, a way, a fifth held change or a doctrine. Attention is the one thing no institution can tax.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Nineteenth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{318}{Bone 19, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the two hundred and tenth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 88. Carry three hundred and seventeen to three hundred and eighteen exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-eight days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and eighteen days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 10 through 18 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — not the first reading, not the four arithmetics, not the stayed-at-the-inch object, not the early letting-go. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months is corrected. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: the stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle set beyond his reach. Both true, the second louder, the argument the work (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty (T061/T082). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, counts small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lifts the twice-mended pot with the thumb first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack left showing, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread; the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092). Four arithmetics in Berr's locked box behind one printed figure with no signature, the finding on a place of its own and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stay two objects and are not made again. Answer 211 in the morning: a small intake let go whole on the river's note, straight down, exact, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, no payer named. Bone 20 stands one morning ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it.

scenes.title: What the Yard Went Around on Bone 19
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 318, no new dated heading: afternoon through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well, the flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate, gives the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, sets him level and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow clay pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out — no eighth likeness stood up as a row and no figure spoken over the going (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). Three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause: the stayed frost gone off the north lip while the yard looked elsewhere, the skin on the trough, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet (T083/T085 held). The dressed grain lies under wool at the rack end, turned with a lighter touch and given no figure, read over by the arithmetic of Bone 10 that did not know what it cost (T077). Bone's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures: a man come down from Cold Acre with a hare asks what the carrying cost and is told to ask the weather, going off toward the clay road with nobody weighing the hare and nobody opening a slate; another with a cracked jar in a rope sling is told to ask the pot, and the pot, being a pot, says nothing. Tarn at the kindling keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the clip-ring holding light, his stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031). Jorra at the wheel-shed edge parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the note known three turns ahead from a High Kiln master who would call it early, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T035/T031/T062). Garl stays in objects — salt coat, hollow wheel-seat, unswept lines, twice-mended pot with the crack showing — and his name is unspoken three hundred and eighteen days; no collector came up the clay road or went down it. Answer 212 at the going of the light: a small intake let go whole on the river's note, straight down, not staying and not early. Carried up at the half-pace, set on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, fold righted without a look at his face, thread left. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap; the reading one morning ahead is not brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment.

scenes.title: The Reading at the Cross
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{319}{Bone 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the roof into the morning of the month's second Account-day and market at the Cross. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 19 comes in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry three hundred and eighteen to three hundred and nineteen exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-nine days told by nobody (T071/T072); the fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and nineteen days (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; the surgeon's knowing that a cold patient cannot clot buys nothing at two inches of air while the infant's want of the crust is louder, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella carries him down at the half-pace and sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, and gives the wool and the river wind the instruction and never the basket (T058/T079). The chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047): Bone's second reading comes to the Cross and changes the district's arithmetic for the month a second time in a way that cannot be changed back. Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passes a finger over the figure, reads One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred and sends the figure twice over the basket — once for the moot and once for the late households — calls the levy and denies it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and goes off up the clay road toward High Kiln with the box locked and Bone's second true subtraction inside beside Frost's three and Bone's first, believing he has done a kindness. Five arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure: five are five and not one account, the printed figure stands unchallenged, the figure read is still not the figure paid and no signature stands on the space. A rule made from the five would want a payer put under all five and none stood; the boy keeps the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine, and does not lay it across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the stayed-at-the-inch object, the early letting-go or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between. The reading answers nothing for the hare gone into the weather, the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188 or the dressed grain read over by a number that did not know what it cost. The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, heard beside told, and its gap is not made a seventh of the hearings or a payer (T078, T061/T082). Hessa Rale carries Berr's slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on and unread, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, answering the women who ask what she carries with I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which — not made a reader by the fifth arithmetic, no figure off the slate, her eighth hand eight and not a rule (T080). The soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls (T090); a silent woman's green at the pot board and a foundling's shape in cast-offs at the market's edge stay a seventh of each with no eighth, no name and no loaf (T050/T051, T033/T034). Answer 213 in the moot-post's shade: the hand goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, lets it go whole on the same low note and comes straight down — exact, worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, not a sign of the reading, not laid across the five arithmetics or made a hearing of the bell's gap. The staying and the early letting-go are not brought to the reading and are not repeated there.

scenes.title: Five Behind One
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Bone 20 through the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate, says nothing about where they have been or what was read over him, sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face and leaves the thread. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number; the three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085 held). The dressed grain lies under wool at the rack end and is turned with a still lighter touch and no figure; the arithmetic that went up the road this morning did not know what it cost and has not come back as a lesson or mending (T077). At the well Ilva draws with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; asked what the firings of Bone have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays, the short strip of notched birch bark is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the charcoal under the shelf, the cord, the open slate a pace away, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood; her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both with a half-beat between the looking and the word, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and goes back to the pail, and nobody turns twice. The boy files the order of reaching as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth, files no tenth, makes no figure of the slate's nearness and does not make her a reader of her own keeping (T080 advanced, not paid). The burned slate stands at five with no sixth, no witness, no hand named at any flame and no payer, carried through the reading unchanged; the claim gathers interest against Jorra's ungiven promise while he neither pays nor refuses (T035/T031/T065/T095). The shut-room tellings stay at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, five openings in five months with the next far off in a later month's first firing, and seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth (T101, T036/T076/T006, T061/T082, T058/T079, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Tarn at the kindling keeps six at the lip beside the unforged sentence, the breath unspent, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check; Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise is neither given nor withdrawn (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062). Five arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account; the finding stays on a place of its own with no payer and is not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). The staying stays one object and the early letting-go one object, neither made again into a habit, a way, a fifth held change or a doctrine. Answer 214 at the going of the light: a small intake let go whole on the river's note, straight down, not staying and not early. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap and every object on its own place.

scenes.title: The Twenty-First Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{320}{Bone 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 19 or 20 comes into this day as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the reading is not re-read. Carry three hundred and nineteen to three hundred and twenty exact, six months and one hundred and forty days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and twenty days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust stiff and leathery two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform; the composed face that is not composure; the infant's want of the crust and the thread louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, the two gaps unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack and says both proverbs to pot and fire with the crack left showing, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and gives it no figure, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and touches the widow's mark at no hour because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092, T077). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell; the told figure beside the paid (T061/T082, T078). Five arithmetics behind one printed figure, five and not one account, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The staying stays one object and the early letting-go one object, neither made again and neither standing up as a habit, a way, a fifth held change or a doctrine (T060/T086, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031). He turns out the file the way he once turned instruments out on a towel at the end of a list, laying each thing on its own place and asking nothing of any of it. Answer 215 in the morning: a small intake let go whole on the river's note, straight down, restraint not payment, no payer named. He has stopped expecting anybody to tell him what the number counts, which is not the same as not wanting it; the older man takes a clean satisfaction in the keeping and the infant underneath wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped — both true, the second louder, neither wins.

scenes.title: The Count Goes On
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 320, Bone 21, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). Three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The returned half-check of Bone 8 stays on its flagstone place with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat: four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause, no payer, and a thing kept by not being made again is still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082). The staying stays one object and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stays one object on its own place and is not made again into a second early letting-go, a rule, a fifth held change or a payer, with a finger between it and the staying and between it and every other object on the sixth (T060/T086, T061/T082). Five arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve unchallenged, figure read still not the figure paid, no signature, five readings five and not one account; the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine, not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the two small objects of the hand or the boy's own gaps — the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047). The holding tray is checked unchanged: burned slate five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame; shut-room two; row five askings with one shaping and no witness; well-saying three shapings; nine hands with Ilva's strip in her sleeve and no tenth; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; six hearings with the seventh place empty; five openings in five months with the next far off; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T080, T036/T076/T006, T058/T079, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Tarn keeps six at the lip with the unforged collector sentence beside it, no collector up or down the clay road; Jorra's dust and damper and the men unnamed before first grey go unasked about and *he's not Vail* stays sealed; Garl stays in objects with name unspoken and tile debt uncalled (T009/T013/T092, T035/T031/T062, T036/T076). Answer 216 at the very end of the day: the hand goes up an inch, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, lets it go whole on the same low note — exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer — and comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold. Two hundred and sixteen honest answers on the sixth place, each an object and not a power; neither the number nor the hand-movings stand up as a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Three hundred and twenty stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and forty days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days with payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken the same number. Nothing on the twenty-first was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended, and the keeping of the number was the only honest work and bought nothing at two inches of air. Bone 30 (Day 329), the month's third and last reading, stands nine mornings ahead in a day that has not earned it and is not brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment.
